title: Seaspell Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Seaspell is a 3 BR / 3 BA / 8 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Welcome to Seaspell! Ideal for any family, this spacious 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom beach cottage will make you feel at home as soon as you step inside.
description_expanded: Description47 West Ruskin Street2 KINGS, 1 QUEEN, 2 TWINS - PET FRIENDLY UP TO 70 LBS.A Newly Renovated Seaside Retreat Steps from the BeachWelcome to Seaspell, a beautifully renovated coastal cottage ideally located just six homes from Seaside’s private beach access. Thoughtfully updated and full of charm, this inviting Seaside, Florida vacation rental offers the perfect balance of comfort, style, and location. Sleeping up to eight guests, Seaspell features generous outdoor living spaces, a private tower with scenic views, and a warm, coastal interior—plus, it’s pet-friendly, so your four-legged family members can join the fun.Inviting Outdoor Living & Classic Seaside CharmGuests are welcomed by a furnished front porch, an ideal spot to enjoy morning coffee while listening to the nearby sounds of the Gulf. Additional outdoor spaces include a screened porch overlooking a spacious backyard, complete with outdoor dining and seating—perfect for relaxed evenings after a day at the beach. Tucked above it all, the private tower offers a peaceful escape with wrap-around views of the treetops and a glimpse of the Gulf beyond.Open-Concept Living with Coastal StyleInside, the first level features soaring ceilings and a light-filled, open-concept design ideal for gathering. The living area offers comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV, while the fully equipped kitchen includes bar seating for three, ample prep space, and everything needed for dining in. A charming dining area and cozy window seat complete the space, making it easy to relax, connect, and unwind.A bonus loft accessed by a ship’s ladder provides additional sleeping space for two guests, adding flexibility for families or groups.Comfortable Bedrooms & Private SuitesThe first floor includes two bedrooms: a welcoming queen bedroom and a spacious king bedroom featuring a flat-screen TV, serene reading nook, ensuite bathroom, and direct access to the screened porch and backyard.The second floor is dedicated entirely to the private king suite—a true retreat complete with a seating area, desk workspace, closet, full-length mirror, and ensuite bath. This level offers added privacy and comfort, making it an ideal primary suite.A Tower Retreat with ViewsAt the top of the home, a bonus tower room awaits. Furnished with a comfortable sofa and flat-screen TV, this space opens onto a wrap-around deck where guests can take in peaceful treetop views and a peek of the Gulf—perfect for sunset watching or quiet moments away from it all.Experience the Magic of SeasideFrom its recent renovation and pet-friendly accommodations to its prime location near the beach and thoughtfully designed living spaces, Seaspell offers a truly memorable Seaside vacation. Whether you’re relaxing on the porch, enjoying the tower views, or strolling to the beach, this charming cottage invites you to slow down and savor the magic of Seaside, Florida.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.* Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $100 per day rental pet fee will be collected, in addition to the flat $150 pet fee, for three-bedroom homes. Pets will not be allowed on furniture. No dog over 70 lbs.Please note: There is nearby construction that may impact your stay. For more information, feel free to contact us directly.FEATURES1,694 square feet1-minute walk, 236 feet to beach accessSeaside private residential beach at West Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private beach on 30APrivate drivewayPeacock Alley linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes included with your stay for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.Pet-friendly, up to 70 lbsSTR23-002090
